text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, maybe I just can't do this...
What if I mess up in some weird way and lose like before—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Losing again... Ugh, I don't want that!
Even I... Even I...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I want to win... I truly do.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...All right! I-I-I'm gonna go win this!!
